Processing Educator will develop and provide orientation, continuing education, competency and training, and staff development for the
60% - Education and Training

Processing Unit . This positions’ primary responsibility is for developing, implementing, tracking and managing all departmental educational activities that include training programs /curriculum and instruction for both newly hired and current staff members. This position will be responsible for writing, reviewing, and updating unit competencies and assisting management in updating and or developing department policy and procedures. Provides support to all staff to maintain Continuing Education Unit (CEU) opportunities offered to employees as well as assistance in certification / re-certification. Incumbent must be able to organize departmental in services and coordinate vendor in- services for continuous training.
